scope: PA map/BM/SBM/GPS duplicate PA number state selection and older PA lot-list parsing
fixes: Selected negeri wins when exact PA exists there, even if the same PA number exists elsewhere.
Geometry failure no longer triggers a silent cross-negeri PA switch.
Cross-negeri auto-detect scans all states before deciding and reports ambiguity.
Transient preferred-state search failure is fail-safe and never treated as proof of another state.
PA detail parser can read non-link lot cells and expand safe numeric ranges such as 77387-77397.
